intro: This report matches your 12 ranked SSM® strengths and your career interests to occupations in the O*NET® database. Occupations that do not fit your interests have been left out, and only the strongest matches are shown.
interestsNote: From the O*NET® Interest Profiler. Longer bars mean stronger interest.
matchesNote: Your 25 best-matching occupations, in order of fit. Stars show how well each one fits your ranked strengths: 5 stars is the strongest fit. Occupations that do not match your career interests have been left out.
summaryBoth: Your strongest career interests are in {areas} activities, while your characteristic strengths suggest particular alignment with roles requiring {strengths}.
summaryStrengthsOnly: Your characteristic strengths suggest particular alignment with roles requiring {strengths}.
archetypeIntro: Each of your 12 strengths has a Work Archetype. They are listed from your highest-ranked strength to your lowest:
attribution: Career interest results come from the O*NET® Interest Profiler. Changes were made: occupation Work Styles were mapped by ShawSight to the 12 SSM® strengths, and results are shown as star ratings.
fitNotCompetence: SSM® adds a personality dimension to an established interest-based occupational matching framework.
The table above assesses occupational fit, not competence.
These occupations are those that best align with your interests and characteristic strengths.
Your current skills, qualifications and experience determine your readiness to move into these occupations.
